name: Rotterdam Marathon
description: The Rotterdam Marathon is known for its fast and flat course through the heart of Rotterdam. With enthusiastic crowds lining the streets, it's one of the fastest marathons in the world.

cityInfo.transportInfo: Rotterdam has excellent public transport with metro, tram, and bus services. The RET Day Ticket is a good option for marathon day when moving between viewing spots.

spectatorTips: Use the metro stations (Ⓜ️) as primary viewing spots - they offer easy access and good places to watch
Purchase a RET day ticket for unlimited metro travel between viewing locations
Consider using the Park & Ride (🅿️) at Kralingsezoom if coming by car - it's near the 36km mark
Runners pass Slinge metro station twice (at 13.1km and 15.8km) - perfect for seeing your runner twice with minimal movement
Good metro strategy: Start → Wilhelminaplein (1km) → Zuidplein (18.6km) → Kralingsezoom (36.1km) → Finish
The finish area at Coolsingel gets extremely crowded - arrive at least 45 minutes early
For the fastest runners, view expected passing times in the '<' column; for average runners use the '=' column; and for slower runners use the '>' column in the timetable
Download the official NN Marathon Rotterdam app for real-time tracking
